defects.description: Description: 'cross one leg tightly over the other'. Currently hipAbductL:-8 + hipAbductR:-5 (both slightly ABDUCTED = outward per corrected convention + = adduction/inward, - = abduction/outward). Knees stay on native sides (Lknee_x=-0.190, Rknee_x=0.167) — NOT crossed. Ankles also on native sides (Lankle_x=-0.228, Rankle_x=0.184).

failing_tests.actual: Lankle_x=-0.228, Rankle_x=0.184 (both on native sides — NOT crossed)

regression_risk: low — single-field change. over_support changes true→false because crossed legs raise feet off floor (feet_min_y 0.518→0.485), so the support heuristic now sees COM as off the foot-support polygon. For an armchair seated pose the actual support is the chair SEAT (under hips), not the feet — the heuristic is inappropriate for chair-sit. Anomalies 0→0, Plausibility 0→0 (no regressions).
rationale: Per CORRECTED convention (verified by integrator-1 + workers B/C): hipAbductL + = adduction (inward/cross). For LEFT leg to cross OVER the RIGHT (the more common armchair cross): hipAbductL must be POSITIVE. Currently hipAbductL=-8 (slight outward, not crossed). FIX: hipAbductL -8→25 (inward cross). Verified: Lankle_x -0.228→0.247 (left ankle now on RIGHT side of body, crossed past right ankle at x=0.184), Lfoot_x -0.240→0.281 (left foot on right side, OUTSIDE right foot — 'crossed tightly over' ✓), Lknee_x -0.190→0.052 (left knee near center, crossing). Single-field minimal fix. Other leg (right) remains as the 'under' leg. Hands-on-armrests claim already satisfied (leftWrist y=0.267 at elbow/hip level on left side, rightWrist y=0.407 at elbow level on right side — both plausible 'on armrest' positions). Sit-tall (spine:2 upright) ✓, chin level (head_pitch 2°) ✓.
